title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.1.3
description:
• 🚀 Low-End PC & Ultra Performance Optimization: Streamlined Chromium flags, media blocking, and RAM garbage collection for smooth execution on low-spec PCs.
• ⚡ Direct Background OTP Polling: Zero browser tabs opened for OTP, preventing window resize and flicker.
• 🎨 Modern Design & Glassmorphism: Polished stat cards with colored accents, sleek status terminal strip, and refined button aesthetics.
• 🛡️ Strict OTP Verification: 'otp not received' error with zero UID disclosure until OTP is confirmed submitted.
